descriptionText: Workflow conditions that combine fenced expressions with YAML multiline block scalars can evaluate incorrectly, always returning true. When a condition uses the literal (|) or folded (>) YAML block scalar style with a fenced expression like ${{ false }}, the trailing newline from the block scalar makes the entire condition a non-empty string (e.g., 'false\n'), which is truthy in GitHub Actions. This means the condition will always pass, even when the expression evaluates to false. To fix this, use the stripped block scalar styles (|- or >-) which remove trailing newlines, or use plain scalars without the block style. This issue affects if: conditions on jobs, steps, and reusable workflow calls.
